title: AI-assisted identification of innovative phytochemicals from Aizoon canariense aimed at brachyury protein in chordoma: a computational strategy.
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用AI辅助药物发现和分子动力学模拟靶向脊索瘤TBXT蛋白，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chordoma is an unique and aggressive bone malignancy along with limited therapeutic options, largely due to the undruggable nature of the TBXT oncoprotein. In this study, we employed an AI-assisted drug discovery approach to optimize beta-sitosterol from Aizoon canariense against TBXT. Among the generated analogs, Artificial Intelligence Ligand 2 demonstrated strong inhibitory potential, showing a stable binding free energy of - 81.09 kcal/mol and maintaining conformational stability during a 500 ns molecular dynamics simulation. Key pharmacokinetic parameters revealed blood-brain barrier permeability, high gastrointestinal absorption as well as compliance with Lipinski's rules, while toxicity evaluation predicted moderate acute toxicity (LD(5)(0) = 800 mg/kg, Class IV) with no major systemic risks. Density Functional Theory analysis confirmed molecular stability and reactivity suitable for biological interactions. Overall, these results highlight AI-Ligand 2 as a promising phytochemical derivative for targeting TBXT in chordoma, providing a foundation for future experimental validation and preclinical studies.
abstract_zh: 脊索瘤是一种独特且具有侵袭性的骨恶性肿瘤，治疗选择有限，主要归因于TBXT癌蛋白的不可成药性。在本研究中，我们采用人工智能辅助药物发现方法，优化来自Aizoon canariense的β-谷甾醇以靶向TBXT。在生成的类似物中，人工智能配体2表现出强大的抑制潜力，显示出稳定的结合自由能为-81.09 kcal/mol，并在500 ns分子动力学模拟中保持构象稳定性。关键药代动力学参数揭示了血脑屏障通透性、高胃肠道吸收以及符合Lipinski规则，而毒性评估预测了中度急性毒性（LD(5)(0) = 800 mg/kg，IV类），且无重大全身性风险。密度泛函理论分析确认了适合生物相互作用的分子稳定性和反应性。总体而言，这些结果突显了AI-Ligand 2作为靶向脊索瘤中TBXT的有前景的植物化学衍生物，为未来实验验证和临床前研究奠定了基础。
